title: #91 Peggen Andersson, BMW Dealer Team Sweden BMW M3, BTCC 1991
note: Round 1 look (Silverstone, April): layout from the TV graphics drawing A_grid_r01_silverstone_b_sharp_14 and colours from 'Getty LAT Images - Silverstone 1 April 1991 - Peggen Andersson, BMW Team Sweden, BMW M3 #91, leads Nettan Lindgren (2201201044)' (front-left, teams/_series): white car, yellow and blue stripe along the front wing and from the C-pillar along the rear quarter, red ESSO sticker and BTCC sticker above a white number board with a red edge, Castrol on the rear quarter, 'Andersson' in white on the rear side window. By Brands Hatch (round 6, Getty 2201200910, right side) the stripes were a Castrol-style rainbow; not drawn. Wheels: gold mesh with a polished lip from Getty 2201201044 (on track, sharp; no standing photo of #91 found). Sizes checked against the photos relative to the door height and wheel size (the --compare overlay of the TV drawing was misaligned): stripe band about a fifth of the door height thick (photos; the TV drawing shows it thicker), number board about 13% of the wheelbase wide.
